about: Get an EHS health card for UAE and GCC nationals, residents and visitors.
note: Requirements read from the official EHS service page on the checked date. EHS fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Health card issue. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: One card per person, linked to the Emirates ID but with its own validity
Valid 5 years for UAE and GCC nationals, 1 year for other nationalities
People of determination need medical committee approval of their report
documents: Spouses of UAE nationals: marriage certificate or continuity certificate
Children of UAE mothers: attested UAE birth certificate
Newborns up to 90 days: attested birth certificate, parents' Emirates IDs and marriage certificate
fees: AED 50 for people of determination among expatriates
AED 15 smart services share plus bank and typing centre charges
timing: 8 working days for temporary card and people of determination cases
channels: EHS website, sign in with UAE PASS
